## Problem

Describe the observed behavior and what you expected.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest sanitized input and the exact command or request. Include the commit or version, runtime and operating system.

## Evidence

Paste relevant output or logs with secrets and personal data removed. State whether the issue occurs with the checked-in example or only with another input.

## Checks performed

List tests or troubleshooting steps already attempted. For security vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md rather than publishing exploit details here.
